subject: Cost & performance guardrails — LumenScale onboarding
messages:
From: Evan Lowe <evan@lumenscale.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@lumenscale.ai>
Date: Mon, Jun 1, 2026 at 9:12 AM PDT
Subject: Starting the cost/perf work for Redwood onboarding

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. LumenScale is excited to get started. Before we schedule the engineering kick-off we wanted to create a short list of must-haves from our side so implementation planning and cost estimates line up: 

- Short summary of expected token volume distribution (we'll send sample traffic) and peak qps requirements.
- Recommendations on: batching targets, prefix/KV caching strategy, quantization profile options you recommend for our model family (we primarily run a 13B decoder), and routing policy defaults (fallback tiers, regional vs cost-based routing).
- A mutual action plan with dates and owners (we prefer a 3-week pilot then a progressive canary to prod).

Can you share a template or reference playbook and a quick estimate of where we should expect unit cost reduction with int8 vs int4 quantization? Also, our procurement team will want a short list of security/compliance touches for the Dedicated option.

Attaching a tiny sample of our workload for profiling: initial_workload_sample.json (5000 requests across 3 endpoints).

Thanks — Evan
Evan Lowe
Head of Platform
LumenScale
[Attachment: initial_workload_sample.json (text)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Lowe <evan@lumenscale.ai>, Priya Singh <priya@lumenscale.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, Jun 1, 2026 at 11:08 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Starting the cost/perf work for Redwood onboarding

Evan — great to meet you and thanks for the sample. High level reply and a proposed plan below; I'll schedule a 45-min kickoff for Wednesday.

Quick answers:
- Batching: we'll profile your request size distribution then recommend per-route target batch sizes; goal is to keep median latency within your SLO while increasing token throughput.
- Caching: suggest prefix/KV caching for the three highest-traffic endpoints; we can show expected token savings after a 48-hour capture.
- Quantization: for the 13B family we typically test two profiles in parallel in a pilot — int8-fp32-mixed path (safer, ~20-30% token cost reduction) and an int4 experiment (aggressive, ~40-55% reduction but higher regression risk). Karthik will prepare expected perf delta charts.
- Routing: propose primary -> cost-tier fallback -> regional fallback. We'll configure automated fallback to a cheaper variant under sustained saturation.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) This week: kickoff & telemetry handoff (samples + SLOs) — owners: Marissa (CS), LumenScale.
2) Week 1: Perf baseline & batch/caching config suggestions — owners: Karthik + Monica.
3) Week 2: Quantization experiments (int8 + int4 canaries) with defined regression test set — owners: Eng (Karthik) + CS (Monica).
4) Week 3: Canary rollout & cost model update; handover to ops + runbook delivery — owners: Marissa + Markus.

I've attached our onboarding playbook and a lightweight cost model template we use to surface unit economics. Please confirm the kickoff time (Wed 10–11am PT?) and provide your target latency / P95 SLOs for the endpoints.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: onboard_playbook_v1.pdf]
[Attachment: cost_model_template.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Fwd: Starting the cost/perf work for Redwood onboarding — LumenScale (internal)

Forwarding Evan's notes. Quick internal asks before the kickoff: 

- Monica: can you own the capture window & ensure we have a span-based telemetry sample? Need 48 hours of traffic plus 1 hour at peak.
- Karthik: please pre-generate two candidate quant profiles and an initial estimate of token cost delta (int8 vs int4). Provide rough latency impact at 512 and 1024 token seq lengths.
- Markus: procurement will likely ask for Dedicated SLA language; can you prep a short blurb and point to standard addendums?

I'll take the kickoff and set expectations with LumenScale — target Wed 10am PT. I'll attach the Drive folder with the playbook and the sample that Evan sent: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-lumenscale-onboard

Please reply-all with availability if Wed 10 doesn't work.

Thanks — Marissa

We'd like to run the int8 canary first and hold off on int4 until we validate the regression tests. Also, can you generate a short doc we can share with our procurement folks summarizing Dedicated SLA and data handling?

Looking forward to the kickoff.
